titles.native: 淫獣 ねらわれたアイドル

description:
Ikumi is an up and coming pop singer with millions of fans and a promising acting career. She should be looking at the world through rose-colored glasses, but she`s got man trouble.

The love of her life just isn`t sure he can handle Ikumi`s fame and fortune. To make matters worse, while shooting on location, a jealous co-star finds a strange wooden idol in an abandoned temple, and uses it to invoke a hedeous demon to be the instrument of her revenge. Will Ikumi`s next concert be her last curtain call? She`s about to dicover that there really are fates worse than death.
